prompt.stem: Which description best matches the audible sound in this recording?
prompt.positive: Two sound bursts with a quiet pause between them.
prompt.negative: One continuous sound burst with no quiet pause inside it.

readout.training: Fit only on the 50 previous ESC-50 fold-5 pairs, with no validation-based tuning.
readout.features: Flatten the 16 slots and normalize each recording vector to unit L2 norm.

native_gate.if_pass: Evaluate full minus seed-averaged K=16 on the same pairs and orders. Main metric: both-correct pair rate averaged across orders.
native_gate.if_fail: Report the full-audio control alone. Do not evaluate or infer a K=16 native compression loss on this task.
